bootstrap.implementation: random.Random indices; numpy median and linear percentile; same seed resampling indices across contrasts

statistical_unit: 24 demand seeds; synchronous and lead20us are correlated conditions within seed

synchronous_regression.ci_note: This node uses the same draw-index matrix for all contrasts. Archived main results are preserved; nominal bootstrap endpoints may differ slightly due to random stream allocation.
